opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowship Grants, 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current members of the Royal Historical Society who are early career historians within five years of submitting their corrected doctoral thesis in a historical subject to a UK institution; normally resident in the UK; not in full-time permanent academic employment.
opportunities.summary: Supports career-building research or professional activities in the post-PhD period, enabling early career historians to produce a discrete scholarly outcome (e.g. an article or book proposal). Two rounds in 2026; the 4 September 2026 round is open.

opportunities.title: Martin Lynn Scholarship in African History, 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postgraduate Members of the Royal Historical Society currently studying for a PhD, undertaking postgraduate research in African history.
opportunities.summary: Annual award to assist a postgraduate researcher of African history with their doctoral research.

opportunities.title: Open Research Support Grants, 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current members of the Royal Historical Society who are not postgraduate students or early career researchers (i.e. more than 5 years on from completion of their PhD).
opportunities.summary: Supports historians without access to research funding to visit archives and historical sites, conduct interviews, and attend academic conferences.

opportunities.title: David Berry Fellowship in the History of Scotland and the Scottish People
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current Fellows and Members of the Royal Historical Society, at all career stages from PhD research and beyond.
opportunities.summary: Annual award to undertake research on the history of Scotland and the Scottish people worldwide. The 2026 round closed (6 March 2026); the next call is expected to open in late 2026.

opportunities.title: RHS Workshop Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current Fellows or members of the Royal Historical Society.
opportunities.summary: Grants for historians to come together to pursue projects of shared interest, hosting a day workshop. The 2026 round closed (23 January 2026); the next call is expected from late 2026 for awards in Spring 2027.
